data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to render PDF pages as images on Web, MacOS, Windows, Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Allows opening PDF documents from assets, files, or raw data, and rendering individual pages into image bytes. It supports multiple platforms including Web, macOS, Windows, Android, and iOS.
use_when: You need to display PDF page previews or render PDF pages as images in a Flutter app.
You need cross-platform PDF rendering supporting mobile, desktop, and web.
avoid_when: You want the newer renamed package pdfx instead.
You need complex interactive PDF viewing features out-of-the-box without manual image rendering.
strengths: Supports a wide range of platforms: Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, and Web.
Allows opening documents from assets, files, and bytes.
Provides control over rendering resolution, background color, and image format.
weaknesses: Plugin has been renamed and republished as `pdfx`.
Requires platform-specific setup on Web (PDF.js script tags) and Windows (PDFium version overrides).
data.setup_notes: Requires adding script tags to index.html for Web and optionally overriding PDFium version in CMakeLists.txt for Windows.
